message.content: {"Lawmakers": ["Lawmakers from both the majority UMP party and the opposition found it unwise to turn millions of citizens into potential felons.", "Lawmakers adopted an amendment making mere downloading of one file punishable by a €38 fine.", "Lawmakers from the majority UMP party, the centrist Union for French democracy, and the opposition adopted amendments making it compulsory for publishers of DRM-encumbered content to give specifications to anyone implementing a compatible player."]}
